title: mentha viridis var. tenuiflora
intro: Mentha viridis var. tenuiflora, commonly known as a variant of the spearmint plant, is a type of herbaceous perennial plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, alleviate symptoms of nausea and headaches, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha viridis var. tenuiflora include its carminative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating gastrointestinal issues and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, particularly limonene and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
